scripts.dev: npm run build && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$PWD/.wrangler-config" wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --local --local-protocol https --port 8787
scripts.check: npm run build && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$PWD/.wrangler-config" wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc --outdir build/dry-run
scripts.test:browser: node tests/browser.mjs && node tests/content.browser.mjs && ADMIN_QUALITY_ONLY=1 node tests/content.browser.mjs
